def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Orders that already existed at seed_time
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()

    # Order items of those orders (ts = purchase moment)
    oi_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    oi_orders = pd.merge(
        oi_hist,
        orders_hist[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )

    win_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    win_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    win_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    # ------------------------------
    # ALL-TIME HISTORICAL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    prod_all = oi_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        median_price=("price", "median"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        last_purchase_ts=("ts", "max"),
        first_purchase_ts=("ts", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    prod_all["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - prod_all["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    prod_all["avg_units_per_order"] = prod_all["total_units"] / prod_all["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # ------------------------------
    # WINDOWED FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    oi_30 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_30]
    prod_30 = oi_30.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_30d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_30d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_30d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    oi_90 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_90]
    prod_90 = oi_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_90d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_90d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers_90d=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_90d=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price_90d=("price", "mean"),
        last_purchase_90d=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()
    prod_90["days_since_last_purchase_90d"] = (seed_time - prod_90["last_purchase_90d"]).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    oi_180 = oi_orders[oi_orders["ts"] >= win_180]
    prod_180 = oi_180.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_180d=("order_id", "count"),
        total_orders_180d=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_revenue_180d=("price", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    # ------------------------------
    # ORDER STATUS (only statuses known at seed_time: delivered requires
    # delivery date already recorded before seed_time; otherwise the order
    # could still change status later, so use conservative approximation
    # based only on what happened strictly before seed_time)
    # ------------------------------
    oh = pd.merge(
        orders_hist[["order_id"]],
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    status_known = orders_hist.copy()
    delivered_known = (
        (status_known["order_status"] == "delivered")
        & status_known["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (status_known["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    )
    # for non-delivered statuses, current status at seed_time may differ;
    # count only statuses that are stable/final or clearly already true
    carrier_known = (
        status_known["order_status"].isin(["shipped", "canceled", "unavailable"])
        & status_known["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna()
        & (status_known["order_delivered_carrier_date"] < seed_time)
    )
    canceled_known = (
        (status_known["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"]))
        & (status_known["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
    )
    status_known["known_delivered"] = delivered_known.astype(int)
    status_known["known_shipped"] = carrier_known.astype(int)
    status_known["known_canceled_unavail"] = canceled_known.astype(int)
    status_known["known_created_approved"] = (
        status_known["order_status"].isin(["created", "approved", "invoiced", "processing"])
        & (status_known["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
    ).astype(int)

    oi_orders_status = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        status_known[["order_id", "known_delivered", "known_shipped",
                      "known_canceled_unavail", "known_created_approved"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    ).fillna(0)

    status_feats = oi_orders_status.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_known_delivered=("known_delivered", "sum"),
        n_known_shipped=("known_shipped", "sum"),
        n_known_canceled_unavail=("known_canceled_unavail", "sum"),
        n_known_in_process=("known_created_approved", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()

    # ------------------------------
    # REVIEW FEATURES (only reviews already existing at seed_time)
    # ------------------------------
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][
        ["order_id", "review_score", "review_comment_title", "review_comment_message"]
    ]
    oi_reviews = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        reviews_hist,
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    oi_reviews["has_comment"] = (
        oi_reviews["review_comment_title"].notna() | oi_reviews["review_comment_message"].notna()
    ).astype(int)
    review_features = oi_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        max_review_score=("review_score", "max"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        frac_reviews_with_comment=("has_comment", "mean"),
        days_to_first_review=("review_score", "count"),  # placeholder replaced below
    ).reset_index()
    review_features = review_features.drop(columns=["days_to_first_review"])

    # review coverage: fraction of historical orders that already got a review
    orders_per_prod = oi_orders.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename("orders_total").reset_index()
    review_features = pd.merge(review_features, orders_per_prod, on="product_id", how="outer")
    review_features["review_coverage"] = (
        review_features["total_reviews"].fillna(0) / review_features["orders_total"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    review_features = review_features.drop(columns=["orders_total"])

    # ------------------------------
    # PAYMENT FEATURES (only payments recorded at seed_time)
    # ------------------------------
    if "ts" in payments.columns:
        payments_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    else:
        payments_hist = payments
    payments_hist = payments_hist[
        ["order_id", "payment_type", "payment_installments", "payment_value"]
    ]
    oi_payments = pd.merge(
        oi_orders[["product_id", "order_id"]],
        payments_hist,
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    payment_features = oi_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_value_per_item=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
        num_unique_payment_types=("payment_type", "nunique"),
    ).reset_index()

    dummies = pd.get_dummies(oi_payments["payment_type"], prefix="pay_type")
    oi_pay_d = pd.concat([oi_payments[["product_id"]], dummies], axis=1)
    agg_map = {}
    for col in dummies.columns:
        agg_map[f"pay_{col}_frac"] = (col, "mean")
    payment_type_features = oi_pay_d.groupby("product_id").agg(**agg_map).reset_index() \
        if agg_map else pd.DataFrame({"product_id": prod_all["product_id"]})

    # ------------------------------
    # MERGE ALL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features = prod_all.copy()
    for part in (prod_30, prod_90, prod_180, status_feats,
                 review_features, payment_features, payment_type_features):
        all_features = pd.merge(all_features, part, on="product_id", how="outer")

    # ------------------------------
    # DERIVED FEATURES
    # ------------------------------
    all_features["has_any_sales"] = (~all_features["total_units"].isna()).astype(int)

    all_features["ratio_30d_to_90d_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_180d_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units_180d"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_30d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_30d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    all_features["ratio_90d_to_all_units"] = all_features["total_units_90d"] / all_features["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)

    all_features["avg_days_between_orders"] = np.where(
        all_features["total_orders"] > 1,
        (all_features["days_since_first_purchase"] - all_features["days_since_last_purchase"]) / (all_features["total_orders"] - 1),
        0
    )

    # ------------------------------
    # CLEAN AND REINDEX
    # ------------------------------
    datetime_cols = ["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts", "last_purchase_90d"]
    all_features = all_features.drop(
        columns=[c for c in datetime_cols if c in all_features.columns], errors="ignore"
    )

    all_features = all_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)

    if "has_any_sales" in final_features.columns:
        final_features["has_any_sales"] = final_features["has_any_sales"].fillna(0)

    # fill NaNs: counts -> 0, ratios -> 0, the rest -> 0; anything left -> 0
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0)
    final_features = final_features.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)

    # guarantee numeric dtype
    for col in final_features.columns:
        if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(final_features[col]):
            final_features[col] = pd.to_numeric(final_features[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

    return final_features
